name: Yüz Yıllık Mucize
summary: Ali Tahir, now 130 years old; When he makes an important decision about his life, he encounters Harika. After this encounter and acquaintance, a new page will open for both Harika and Kemal.

name: Hidden Habitats
summary: Hidden habitats that are self-contained ecosystems are explored.

name: Inside Overhaulin'
summary: A retrospective of the greatest moments in Overhaulin' history. Join hosts Chip Foose, Chris Jacobs and Executive Producer Bud Brutsman as they dive in a little deeper on some of the most memorable builds and pranks from past Over

name: New Vanity Fair
summary: Ding Kemang is a talented and reputable theater actor, while his student Song Yang is a popular celebrity. In order to ensure their tickets sell out, the theater troupe cast Song Yang alongside Ding Kemang to act in the play titled Father and Son. Under Ding Kemang's guidance, Song Yang learned to overcome his impulsive nature and withstand the temptation of popularity, and gained an understanding and respect toward the art of performing. Finally, with his hard work, his acting skills improved and he became an actor with both popularity and skills.

name: Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It
summary: About two genius science students who want to find out if love can be solved by a scientific theory.

name: Romance of a Twin Flower
summary:
Adapted from the web novel "The Dreamer in the Spring Boudoir" (春闺梦里人) by Bai Lu Cheng Shuang (白鹭成双).
A quirky genius girl named Ji Man Yi loses her memory through an accident, and inexplicably replaced her twin sister and entered the Hou Manor. With her outstanding wits and business acumen, she managed to resolve numerous crisis, eventually winning the favor of Ning Yu Xuan, the cold and arrogant young master of Hou manor.

name: Tyrant: The Rise of Adolf Hitler
summary:
A radical re-telling of the events that lead to the Second World War, focusing on the period between March 1938 and September 1939.

Throughout the series, a team of leading young historians explain what Adolf Hitler was doing day by day, week by week during this period, looking at each moment through his eyes, and revealing how this tyrant brought the world to the edge of destruction.

name: Michel Roux's Provence Masterclass
summary: Michel Roux draws on decades of experience as a top Michelin-starred chef to create exquisite menus for every occasion.

name: Tempting Fortune
summary: Rob Beckett presents the epic competition with a twist. Twelve strangers trek across hostile jungles and wildernesses, but who'll spend some of the shared £300k prize pot on individual luxuries?

name: Skinner & Mina's Literary Road Trip: Pope & Swift
summary: Frank Skinner and Denise Mina follow in the footsteps of Alexander Pope and Jonathan Swift, two of the most brilliant humorists in the history of literature.

name: Come Follow Up
summary: Host Ben Lomu and special guests take a deeper dive into concepts and doctrines from the Old Testament that correlate with the weekly Come, Follow Me resource. Now expanded to a hour-long format, Come Follow Up complements your personal and family scripture study.

name: Yalancı Yarim
summary: Akarsu portrays a wealthy young man, Tarik Tekelioglu, who goes to Italy for his education but rather becomes the most successful rally driver.

name: Kadin Isterse
summary: Canan, who is married and has two children, loses his beauty over time. She has already been aged over the aesthetic problems that have already existed. In contrast, his wife Zafer is a very well-groomed man. His interest in his wife has diminished over time. The women around them are attracted to attention. Zafer, his assistant is in love with Alev. Candan lived the biggest catastrophe that a woman could ever have.

name: Приехали!
summary: The big star of Eurovision and MUZ-TV Dima Krasilov goes on a journey. He will draw an unusual route on the map, mark the most beautiful places, convey vivid gastronomic impressions and introduce people who will show you familiar cities from the most unexpected side. And of course, he will tell you what you can bring with you from a trip more interesting than a magnet – all this in the new travel show "We have arrived!"

name: La fossa
summary: Young David secretly works in the exhumation of an unencumbered Civil War mass grave in his village, where he thinks his family may be buried. He is murdered, triggering a police investigation that will reveal both past and present crimes.

name: Underdogs
summary: Anything can happen when seven celebrities and their dogs are thrown onto the agility course. Those competing are Anders Bagge, NicoleFalciani, DoggeDoggelito, Theoz, Johanna Lind Bagge, Klara Doktorow and Christian "Kicken" Lundqvist. Which celebrity and dog succeeds best in the competitions and takes home the title of the year's Underdog 2023?

name: Avenir
summary: Eliott, 31, lives with his disabled sister and is bored in his job as a household appliance salesman, which does not interest him. One evening, he had fun sending a message to the first email address he had when he was younger. Following a computer bug, he begins to communicate with the little boy he was 20 years earlier and then sees his life turned upside down. Little and big Eliott will do everything to take their lives back in hand and try to realize their dreams.

name: СТУДИЯ 72
summary: A show in which guys discuss the news and communicate with interesting people.

name: Jussie Smollett: Anatomy of a Hoax
summary: A hate crime ignites national outrage… before it's revealed to be an elaborate hoax. This series unravels a twisty, true crime story of celebrity justice, big-city politics and the competing agendas at the heart of the current culture wars.

name: From Mrs. to Ms.
summary: Join Katie LeBlanc and Andrea Knoche in this new weekly podcast about two divorced besties and their experiences navigating life as a "Ms." instead of "Mrs." With a mixture of storytelling, happy hour confessionals, advice, and the occasional special guest, Katie and Andrea aren't holding anything back anymore – so pull up a chair, and pour a glass ;)

name: Jusqu'ici tout va bien
summary: A journalist's life devolves into chaos when she shields her brother from the law, inadvertently entangling her family in a drug lord's merciless scheme.

name: Alloo SEXpliciet
summary: In Alloo SEXplicit Luk Alloo takes sex work out of the taboo atmosphere. He goes out with men and women who sell sex. They work as porn actors, as prostitutes or as webcammers, but they still encounter prejudices, skewed looks and incomprehension.

name: Gestrand op Honeymoon Island
summary: In this reality show, which combines dating and survival, eight singles are matched with each other under a tropical sun, after which they are left to fend for themselves on a deserted island.

name: La Pluie
summary: Saengtai never believed in destiny or things such as ‘Soulmate' but rather in his ability to make his own choices. In every rainfall, the sound around him silences, making way for the voice of his soulmate to be heard. On the other hand, ‘Phat' patiently waited for the unfamiliar voice but had never been fortunate enough to hear it. Even in the midst of a downpour, the voice of his soulmate was elusive. Their differing beliefs were like a game of tug-of-war played in the rain, with a rope of fate pulled by a stubborn person trying to win the other's heart and a denying person trying to escape the truth. If destiny played a role, would Saengtai be able to go against the will, or would it be Phat, who had been played by destiny?

name: Laws of Attraction
summary: Charn is a smart lawyer who loves to handle high return cases or to bring a big fame towards himself. He can turn wrong into right, regardless of the method. But one day, he was removed from a high-profile case for a hidden reason; this made him feel ashamed and disadvantaged. Charn suspects that this case must have some clues and he must find them to gain his own benefit. He decides to switch the side to help another party Tin, an uncle of Tonkao who was died unfairly in the car accident. Tin tries to do everything to get the justice back to his grandchildren, however; his claim gets the opposite effect. Charn and Tin work together to investigate the truth of the case, this leads to a good feeling towards each other. But the more they investigate, the more dangerous it becomes.

name: Klimatkampen
summary: Fyra kända svenskar - Julia Dufvenius, Dragomir Mrsic, Ellen Bergström och Farao Groth - flyttar in på en ekogård redo att ändra på sina vanor och leva mer klimatsmart. Under ledning av Mark Levengood utmanas och inspireras de till att tänka nytt kring mat, transporter, konsumtion och invanda mönster. Klimatpsykolog Kata Nyhlén coachar deltagarna och ger dem verktyg för en hållbar omställning. Kommer de klara att leva ett mer klimatsmart liv?

name: Wildlife Nation with Jeff Corwin
summary: Wildlife Nation shines light on our country's spectacular wildlife and the real and achievable solutions for conservation, from your backyard to the most remote wild places," said Jamie Rappaport Clark, Defenders of Wildlife President and CEO. "We are excited to partner with Jeff Corwin, a longtime supporter of Defenders' mission, to showcase conservation heroes in action as they work tirelessly with us to defend and restore wildlife across the nation.
